confidence_levels.high: encoding and operation established by independent checks
confidence_levels.medium: statistically established or a single confirmed example; a sign or width may still be open
confidence_levels.format-only: the shape (which units pair) is established but the operation is not: mnemonic starts with "." or ends with "?"

meta.form_order: the forms list is ordered: the first form of the right width whose mask/value (+ constraints, slot rule) matches wins
meta.bit_numbering: global over the concatenated big-endian units: width-1 = bit 15 of the head; 32-bit: head 31..16, tail 15..0; 48-bit: head 47..32, hi 31..16, lo 15..0

structure.unit: 16-bit big-endian halfword; instructions are 1, 2 or 3 units (16/32/48 bits); 16-bit forms are matched with bit 15 masked out unless the form says otherwise

packet.close_bit: bit 15 of a unit = 1 closes the packet (S2); a packet = consecutive units up to and including the first unit with bit 15 = 1 (max 8 units = 128 bits)
packet.alignment: packets start at addr % 4 == 0 and == 2 alike
packet.head: a unit with bit 15 = 0 that is the first unit of an instruction; a head without tail is a 16-bit op with the packet still open
packet.tail: a unit that completes a 32-bit (1 tail) or 48-bit (2 tails: hi, lo) instruction; only the last unit of the packet has bit 15 (S) = 1
packet.layout: heads first, then tails distributed round-robin among the heads that take tails (S S O O; x008 X hi hi' lo lo'): round r gives the next free tail to every head that takes more than r tails, in head order
packet.groups: a packet is a sequence of GROUPS, each with the heads-first layout; one group = full round-robin, one-instruction groups = contiguous layout (exception handler, b/call + delay slot), mixtures H H T T H T exist; no bit selects the layout: the decoder enumerates every group split and keeps the reading with the fewest unknown units (then fewest instructions, fewest groups, tie-break penalties below)
packet.acceptance: a head may take a tail (or a hi+lo pair) iff some form of this table matches the head and the tail(s); a head may stand alone as a 16-bit unit (named form or .hword) unless listed in must_pair; ret/save/restore never take tails

must_pair.why: op C with F = 0 is always the head of a DSP/basop pair

packet.last_unit_rule: a packet of >= 3 units whose last unit (bit 15 = 1) is a named 16-bit op may also be read as <parse of the first n-1 units> + that op
tie_breaks: an O syllable (unit with bits 13:11 = 111, i.e. 78-7f / f8-ff) that is not the tail of an op 7 head: +0.75
a 16-bit movi with bits 15:14 = 00 used as a tail: +0.5
ld.w/st.w with a 12-bit offset not multiple of 4, ld.h/st.h odd: +0.5
loose 4000 read as nop without closing the packet: +0.5
control-flow target not at a packet boundary: +1.5
packet.first_slot: only the first unit of the packet (slot 0) can be control flow: branches, call/b, loop, ret, 16-bit branches, call.abs/b.abs (S6); the same encodings in other slots are mov/add/op C etc.
packet.control_tail_adjacency: the tail of a branch/call/loop must be at +1 (S = 1) or at +2 at most (S = 0, S S O O layout); tails farther away give random targets
packet.delay_slot: when the control instruction does not close the packet (S = 0 tail, or bit 15 = 0 head: call, b, b<cond>.d, ret.d, b.s, call rB, call.abs/b.abs), the REST OF THE PACKET is the delay slot: it executes on both paths and the condition uses the values before the slot (0/26,281 packets have two control instructions); no evidence that the slot reaches the next packet
packet.parallelism: units of a packet execute in parallel (after ld rD the next unit reads rD 19.7 % inside the packet vs 45.8 % across packets)

registers.gpr: r0-r15 (4-bit fields h:rrr or B); no r16-r31
registers.args: r0-r7 (r0-r3 most used), stack args > r7 stored with st.w [sp], #imm
registers.return: r0 (r0:r1 for 64 bits; 64-bit products live in Ak)
registers.callee_saved: r8-r10, r12, r13 and r8!-r14! via save w; r11 caller-saved
registers.high_bank: bit x (bit 8 of 16-bit ops / head bit 8 / i4 of cmov / odd X cells) selects a second register bank, printed rN!; its size is unknown
registers.accumulators: A0-A3, 3 words each (lo, hi, ext); read with mfacc rA, w (w = 3k + part); extended CSR 0x30 + 4k + part
registers.csr_classic_access: mfcr rB, csrN / mtcr csrN, rB (op 4 + [S][100][0][d][0...0]); st.w/ld.w with x = 1 in the exception handler (st.w.x csrN)
registers.csr_extended: 0x01-0x3e via mfcsr rB, #nn / mtcsr #nn, rB; groups 0x01-0x05 (status), 0x10-0x14, 0x20-0x26, 0x30-0x3e = A0-A3 x (lo, hi, ext)
registers.flags: none: all branches are compare-and-branch; no cmp instruction

structure.hardware_loops: loop rX, last=pc+disp12: counter in rX, END ADDRESS INCLUSIVE (last instruction of the body), body 1-16 instructions, nestable (ls0-2/le0-2/lc0-2 CSRs); sys #3 cancels the loop

conditions.index: tail bits 13:12 (t2) select the condition inside each op; imm8 = x:B:t[11:9] signed (unsigned for op 8 t2 < 2)
conditions.delay_variants: F = S = 0 cells validated >= 85 %: blt.d beq.d (op 9), bltu.d (op 8), bgt.d bgtu.d (op a), all four op d, bltu.d (op c t2=11), bne.d rA,#-1 (op 9 t2=00 only with imm8 = -1)

displacements.bcond_imm8: disp = sext9(t[0]:t[8:1]) * 2 (tail bit 0 is the sign)
displacements.b16: disp = sext7(D:d6) * 2 with D = bit 13 (d6 - 64 when D = 1); bz.s with bit 15 = 0: 2*d6 forward
displacements.call_b: disp = sext22(b0:hi10:lo11) * 2 (b0 = tail bit 0 = bit 21; hi10 = head bits 13:4; lo11 = tail bits 11:1); near b: hi10 in {0, 0x3ff} with b0 == hi10[9]
displacements.pc: pc = address of the head unit

immediates.rot(f, n): rotated field, bit 0 = sign: imm = sext((f >> 1) | ((f & 1) << (n - 1)), n); used by op 0/1 (rot12), op 6/2 (rot10), .op4imm (rot12)
immediates.ld/st off12: sext12 bytes, unscaled (ld.b field 0x800 prints as +1)

field_types.reg: general register index (4 bits unless noted)
field_types.disp: signed pc-relative displacement (scale applied) -> target = pc + value
field_types.flag: 1-bit flag; in format strings {name:text} prints text when the flag is 1 ({x:!} prints the high-bank "!")
field_types.bits: list of [hi, lo] ranges in global bit numbering, MSB first, concatenated; ["z", n] = n implicit zero bits

context_rules.name: lo_after_hi
context_rules.rule: a .hword unit whose previous raw unit is a hi(1010) syllable is the lo syllable of a 48-bit instruction whose head is elsewhere (format-only)

context_rules.name: ext_after_ldst
context_rules.rule: a final unit [1][1][1][1][rrr][0][B][0111] (16-bit movi r8-15) two units after a ld/st whose single tail has S = 0 is an extension unit of that access, not a movi

context_rules.name: be79_prefix
context_rules.rule: a bare head [0][0][imm14] without a named reading followed by be79 (nop) = .be79 #imm14: DTCM address prefix, operation open

context_rules.name: bz_s_P4
context_rules.rule: see form bz_s_P4: [0][1][0][h][rrr][x][B][1101] opening a 2-unit packet without a named pairing = bz.s rA, pc + 2*d6

constraint_ops.packet_len: packet must have exactly n units
constraint_ops.guard setcc_tail: tail unit not a named 16-bit op unless f12 in small
